gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns applying a derivative formula to every observable in the pointwise generator domain, including nonsmooth observables. ISSUE-001 concerns an incorrect Suzuki coefficient and failed order conditions, with no diagnosis of generator-domain regularity or differentiability.

The gold issue is a missing justification connecting weaker bi-continuous generator definitions to norm generators in the Lie-Trotter derivation. ISSUE-003 diagnoses a miswired intermediate state in a separate third-order coordinate algorithm, not a continuity or generator-identification gap.

The gold issue concerns unsupported first-order global error control and the missing O(h^2) local-defect and regularity assumptions for Lie-Trotter. ISSUE-003 instead identifies an incorrect input in one algorithmic step; it does not diagnose missing rate assumptions or establish the distinct local-to-global error obligation.

The gold issue concerns an unsupported second-order Strang global rate requiring an O(h^3) local defect, cancellation, and domain bounds. ISSUE-003 concerns a malformed third-order implementation and does not identify the missing Strang rate hypotheses or local-defect estimate.

The gold issue is that complex coefficient rays may not lie in analytic semigroup sectors, so the factors may be undefined. ISSUE-003 uses complex coefficients in a separate five-exponential algorithm but diagnoses only the discarded intermediate state and supplies no analytic-sector or complex-time existence condition.

The gold issue is dropping the leading product power in a telescoping estimate and lacking uniform power stability. ISSUE-002 concerns a wrong scalar coefficient in a displayed recursive splitting expansion and does not diagnose stability of powers or the resulting global error bound.

The gold issue is that full-flow invariance does not imply invariance of frozen coordinate subflows, so coordinate Koopman operators may be undefined. ISSUE-003 identifies a wrong intermediate variable in an otherwise specified third-order composition and does not diagnose frozen-flow invariance or state-space escape.

The gold issue is that the real-time flow contract does not define the complex-time frozen maps required by the third-order routine. ISSUE-003 concerns an incorrect state passed between real or formally specified substeps and does not recognize the missing complex extension of the flow or state domain.
